You will research international companies, identify potential business opportunities, and maintain reliable information to help our team connect with suitable prospects. Find relevant decision-makers and publicly available business contact details. Collect and organize information such as company names, websites, services, locations, and contact profiles. Identify public posts and business requirements related to software development and remote developers. Verify information, remove duplicate entries, and keep research records updated. Maintain structured data in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or CRM tools. Share relevant findings with the business development team and meet agreed research targets. Follow company guidelines for data accuracy, confidentiality, and responsible information collection. Required Skills and Qualifications Graduate in any discipline. Strong attention to detail and the ability to organize information. Patience and persistence when searching for accurate, relevant results. Willingness to learn new research methods and tools. Ability to follow instructions, manage time, and work collaboratively. Good to Have Familiarity with LinkedIn and advanced Google search. Basic understanding of IT services and software development.
